The '''Droma sector''' was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], between [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]] and [[Glythe sector/Legends|Glythe sector]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lonnaw]], the first stop of ''[[Outbound Flight]]''.

Decades later, the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] [[Elite (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Elite'']] during the [[Operation Grain Snatch]] received a shipment of [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] [[Grain/Legends|grain]] intended for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troops in Droma Sector, which led to the execution of [[Ghorin]].
